subject: Maths
title: Simplifying ratios
subtitle: Ratio · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can simplify ratios by dividing both sides by their highest common factor.

key_vocab.definition: To simplify a ratio, divide all parts by their highest common factor (HCF). A ratio is in its simplest form when the parts share no common factor other than 1.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can simplify ratios by dividing both sides by their highest common factor.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: simplify a ratio -- To simplify a ratio, divide all parts by their highest common factor (HCF). A ratio is in its simplest form when the parts share no common factor other than 1.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Divide every part of the ratio by the highest common factor to simplify.
a : b = &frac{a}{HCF} : &frac{b}{HCF}
Keep dividing until no common factor remains

Key examples:
  ✓ 12 : 18 = 2 : 3  (divide both by HCF 6)
  ✓ 1.5 : 2.5 = 3 : 5  (multiply by 2 first to remove decimals)
  ✓ 40 cm : 1 m = 40 : 100 = 2 : 5  (convert to same unit)
  ✗ 12 : 18 = 6 : 9  (not fully simplified)
  ✗ 40 cm : 1 m = 40 : 1  (units not converted)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – whole numbers
  Simplify 24 : 36
  Find HCF of 24 and 36 = 12
  24 ÷ 12 = 2
  36 ÷ 12 = 3
  2 : 3
  (Always find the largest factor that divides both numbers.)

Example 2 – three-part ratio
  Simplify 10 : 15 : 25
  Find HCF of 10, 15, and 25 = 5
  Divide each: 10 ÷ 5 = 2, 15 ÷ 5 = 3, 25 ÷ 5 = 5
  Simplified ratio: 2 : 3 : 5
  2 : 3 : 5
  (The same method works for three-part ratios.)

sections.title: Different units
sections.content:
Convert to the same unit, then simplify.

(a) 50 cm : 2 m
(b) 300 g : 1.5 kg
(c) 20 min : 1 hour
(d) 750 ml : 2 litres

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 12 : 18 simplifies to 2 : 3 (divide by 6)
✗ 12 : 18 simplifies to 6 : 9 and that is the simplest form
✓ To simplify a ratio with decimals, multiply to make whole numbers first
✗ 40 cm : 1 m = 40 : 1 because we just drop the units
✓ A ratio is fully simplified when the HCF of all parts is 1
